verdicts.title: Exact Ramsey Theory: Green-Tao numbers and SAT
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We consider the links between Ramsey theory in the integers, based on van der Waerden's theorem, and (boolean, CNF) SAT solving. We aim at using the problems from exact Ramsey theory, concerned with computing Ramsey-type numbers, as a rich source of test problems, where especially methods for solving hard problems can be developed. In order to control the growth of the problem instances, we introduce "transversal extensions" as a natural way of constructing mixed parameter tuples (k_1, ..., k_m)
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses Ramsey theory, Green-Tao numbers, and SAT encoding schemes for test problems, with no mention of local ring norms or clause indicator polynomials. It shares only the SAT vocabulary but does not interact with the conjecture's specific claim about Θ(c^(1/2)) bounds.

verdicts.title: Dsat: A Native SAT Solver for Discrete Logic

verdicts.title: Poincaré series of compressed local Artinian rings with odd top socle degree
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We define a notion of compressed local Artinian ring that does not require the ring to contain a field. Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a compressed local Artinian ring with odd top socle degree $s$, at least five, and $\operatorname{socle}(R)\cap \mathfrak m^{s-1}=\mathfrak m^s$. We prove that the Poincaré series of all finitely generated modules over $R$ are rational, sharing a common denominator, and that there is a Golod homomorphism from a complete intersection onto $R$.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns Poincaré series and Golod homomorphisms of compressed local Artinian rings ('the Poincaré series of all finitely generated modules over $R$ are rational'), with no mention of SAT, clause set complexity, indicator polynomials, or any norm asymptotics relevant to the conjecture.
